incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Alert — corpomega VPC: inability to fetch per-tenant traces/logs for tenant corpomega-prod. Errors observed since 02:12 UTC. Paging oncall-sre. Incident ID: INC-2026-0457
Amy (oncall-sre): I'm on it. seeing 403s when trying to hit the log-forwarder endpoint for corpomega-prod.
Miguel (eng-sre): Can you paste the curl and response?
Amy (oncall-sre): sure — from operator session in us-west-2:```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' https://log-forwarder.corpomega.internal/api/v1/streams/corpomega-prod/traces
*   Trying 10.11.5.22...
* Connected to log-forwarder.corpomega.internal (10.11.5.22) port 443 (#0)
> GET /api/v1/streams/corpomega-prod/traces HTTP/1.1
> Host: log-forwarder.corpomega.internal
> Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< content-type: application/json
< content-length: 87
< {
  "error": "access_denied",
  "detail": "cross-account role not found"
}
```
Raj (eng-infra): this smells like the cross-account IAM role the forwarder uses to assume the customer logging role didn't get created during the recent VPC onboarding patch. We rolled a migration yesterday.
Lucas (eng-ml): customers' traces are routed to our per-tenant trace indexer which requires the forwarder to list S3 partitions. If role missing -> no traces and metric partition reads return empty sets.
Jane (customer-succ): Dan from CorpOmega is online and reporting that their app logs are arriving to their side but not visible in Redwood console. They can confirm we have their approval to perform read-only access for diagnostics.
Dan (CorpOmega-ops): confirmed. Happy to enable cross-account role or temporary access, whichever is faster. We need minimal blast radius, prefer ephemeral read-only.
Amy (oncall-sre): quick plan: 1) request corpomega to attach temporary cross-account role with the ARN I post below (read-only) 2) if they can't, spin up a temporary forwarder proxy in corpomega VPC with customer-provided deploy key 3) roll a safe IAM migration rollback if the migration caused deletion. We need decision in next 15m.
Sam (oncall-manager): +1 to ephemeral forwarder if trust is low. But if customer consents to role it's faster. escalation to eng-infra if we touch infra.
Raj (eng-infra): I'm standing by. If Dan can create role I can test assume-role in ~3m. ARN we need: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-corpomega-forwarder-readonly` (put minimal policy below)
Raj (eng-infra): policy snippet:
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::corpomega-logs-*","arn:aws:s3:::corpomega-logs-*/*"]}
  ]
}
```
Dan (CorpOmega-ops): creating role now. ETA 4m. I'll DM you the role ARN once created.
Amy (oncall-sre): great. meanwhile I'll try to reproduce locally with a sim role to validate nothing else is broken. Miguel can you check if the recent migration has any rollback flag?
Miguel (eng-sre): migration logs show a `delete-role-if-orphaned` step that ran at 01:59 UTC and removed roles with no last-used tag. Looks like corpomega's role wasn't tagged correctly during onboarding. I'm filing a rollback path.
Lucas (eng-ml): note — until traces return, model-based evaluation against corpomega prompt sets will show higher false-positive alert rates. We'll flag dashboards.
incident-bot: Update: INC-2026-0457 severity remains P1. channel#incidents notified.
Dan (CorpOmega-ops): role created and attached. ARN: `arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-corpomega-forwarder-readonly` — sent DM to Amy.
Amy (oncall-sre): received. testing assume-role...```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-corpomega-forwarder-readonly --role-session-name redwood-diagnose
```
Amy (oncall-sre): assume-role succeeded. re-running curl against forwarder yields 200 and traces streaming now.
Miguel (eng-sre): can confirm indexer has started ingesting corpomega-prod trace batches. p95 trace latency now visible in console.
Raj (eng-infra): I'll push a small IaC patch to ensure onboarding tags role with `redwood:onboarded=true` to stop future garbage collection. Deploying to infra-staging then prod.
Sam (oncall-manager): nice. can you include a one-time migration to restore roles that were deleted by that garbage collector? Miguel, coordinate with Raj.
Miguel (eng-sre): on it. queued migration script: `restore-roles-by-onboard-timestamp.sh` will recreate missing roles for customers onboarded in last 30 days. running dry-run now.
Jane (customer-succ): Dan says they can confirm logs now visible. Customer happy. They asked for a short summary for their compliance team.
Amy (oncall-sre): quick incident summary to paste to CorpOmega: "Root cause: onboarding tagging bug triggered garbage-collector migration which deleted cross-account read-only role used by the Redwood log-forwarder. Impact: corpomega-prod traces and per-tenant metrics were not visible in Redwood console (02:12-02:52 UTC). Mitigation: CorpOmega temporarily created read-only cross-account role to restore ingestion. Permanent fix: onboarding tagging enforced and migration rollback + role restore. No data loss; only ingestion delay."
Sam (oncall-manager): I'll pin this and create a follow-up postmortem ticket. assign to eng-infra + eng-sre + devex for docs.
Lucas (eng-ml): i'll add a temporary dashboard alert that will fire if indexer sees `0` partitions for a tenant for >5m. helps catch this class of issue.
Miguel (eng-sre): follow-up: running role-restore now. estimated 2h for batch restore, but critical tenants (enterprise) prioritized first.
Amy (oncall-sre): closing incident once we have confirmation of permanent fix and roles restored. last checks in 30m. thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INC-2026-0457 updated: status=mitigated, assignees=[Raj (eng-infra), Miguel (eng-sre)], sla-impact=partial (metrics visibility), duration=00:40:00
Dan (CorpOmega-ops): thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Jane (customer-succ): marking as resolved on our side.
Sam (oncall-manager): good job. we'll draft RCA and share within 48h.
Amy (oncall-sre): note to self: add checklist item to onboarding playbook: verify `redwood:onboarded` tag and test assume-role post-onboard.
Miguel (eng-sre): adding postmortem link once created."
